title: File:Approaching Nancy Holt's earthen sculpture, Star-Crossed, on the campus of Miami University's Art Museum in Oxford, Ohio on 13 April 2022.jpg
author: Matthew.kowal
description: Approaching Nancy Holt's earthen sculpture, Star-Crossed, on the campus of Miami University's Art Museum in Oxford, Ohio on 13 April 2022. From this vantage the viewer can see through the walking tunnel. The observation tunnel pertrudes through the mound at an angle. Only the very top of the reflecting pool is visible to the right of the mound.

title: File:The reflecting pool and observation tunnel of Nancy Holt's earthen sculpture, Star-Crossed, on the campus of Miami University's Art Museum in Oxford, Ohio on 13 April 2022.jpg
author: Matthew.kowal
description: The reflecting pool and observation tunnel of Nancy Holt's earthen sculpture, Star-Crossed, on the campus of Miami University's Art Museum in Oxford, Ohio on 13 April 2022. The reflecting pool is visible in the foreground and the observation tunnel is in the mid-ground. From this vantage the tunnel for walking runs horizontally through the mound.

title: File:Downtown Springfield, Ohio - 1579116927.jpg
author: Cindy Funk
description: As in most cities, old juxtaposed with the new. That's the Bushnell Building , the red one on the left.  It used to be the Wren's Department Store.  In it's day, "The" place to shop for the best merchandise.  Needless to say, we didn't shop there much. 8-)

title: File:Downtown Cafe, Springfield, Ohio.jpg
author: Cindy Funk
description: It's little Mom and Pop joints like this that make a town what it is.  Our downtown is mostly dead, but there are a few breakfast/lunch places downtown, within walking distance for workers in the banks and city offices.

title: File:Montage of architecture, Downtown Springfield Ohio.jpg
author: Cindy Funk
description: As with most cities, downtown Springfield is a montage of many styles, many ages.  The more modern building on the right is the City Building. The reddish building Bushnell Building, once Wrens, among others.

title: File:Springfield Downtown Lights.jpg
author: Cindy Funk
description: Lights on the left is City Hall, and the white lights of trees around the plaza.  The red and green lights are on the bank across the street.

title: File:State Theatre, Springfield, Ohio - entrance.jpg
author: Cindy Funk
description:
State Theatre, Springfield, Ohio.

Our two downtown movie theatres still exist, though not playing movies. The State has recently been renting out to groups. I went to a showing of a silent film there, and it was brilliant. They have also had dances there. Not everything has been smooth, however - there was a Latin dance that turned violent. One was slain and two arrested. Not the kind of re-start
